model.title: Establishing the congressional budget for the United States Government for fiscal year 2027 and setting forth the appropriate budgetary levels for fiscal years 2028 through 2036.

summary.text: The concurrent resolution would establish the federal government's budget for fiscal year 2027 and set spending and revenue targets through 2036. It directs four House committees to propose legislation that would increase the deficit within specified limits by September 11, 2026, and establishes procedures for considering such legislation using expedited parliamentary rules. The measure also creates a reserve fund for budget adjustments and sets enforcement rules for discretionary spending, emergency funds, and relief for disasters, wildfires, and other specified purposes.
